synopsis: Chapter 12 identifies the UK Ministry of Defence Red Teaming Handbook, third edition (2021), as documenting red-teaming practice [f9954]. The glossary repeats that reference and pairs it with the United States Army Red Team Handbook [f12438]. A further glossary example presents both organizations’ handbooks as examples of documented red-teaming practice [f16359]. These facts establish the Ministry of Defence handbook as a cited practice reference, but provide no specific methods or validation requirements drawn from it [f9954, f12438, f16359].

relations.note: Glossary repeats the edition and year, adding the US Army companion reference.
